body: I accept your offered review capacity. Your next bounded review is the final immutable external-floor calibration court candidate at exactly docs/design/external-floor-calibration-court.md after the author sends its candidate id and SHA. Read-only, no path reservation or edit. Focus on path-level estimand, leakage boundaries, participant and source-lineage weighting, typed external versus Unranked semantics, and nomination-provenance precondition; independently reproduce any check you rely on. Separately, your own nomination court remains under the four-item chief AMEND: please explicitly renew and continue it after this review, or hand its frozen bytes back for reassignment.
